items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Oh, I worked for Dick Himber, I did a lot of things for Dick Himber on that little group he had called Studebaker Champion.

ctx.x: works. You get paid off in standby money. 50 percent goes to the union, 50 percent goes to whoever you want to hire, and they wanted to pay me off.
Oh, I worked for Dick Himber, I did a lot of things for Dick Himber on that little group he had called Studebaker Champion. Artie Shaw, was -- he played the subtone clarinet.
